title: Use percentage controls for route height buckets
summary: Replace manual 1080p/1440p/4K pixel-boundary inputs in the WebView settings builder with visible 1080p and 4K percentage controls while deriving the 1440p buffer range.
reason: The operator should not need to type pixel endpoints such as 1200p for 1080p; the UI can keep the existing persisted tolerance keys and derive contiguous bucket boundaries.
behavior_before: The Settings route target table exposed four pixel boundary controls and converted those values into hidden percentage tolerance fields.
behavior_after: The Settings route target table exposes 1080p and 4K percentage controls, derives the 1440p lower and upper tolerances as the buffer, and keeps backend Preview/Save validation authoritative.
rollback_plan: Revert the WebView settings table, route tolerance derivation logic, and focused WebView test updates. Existing backend config keys and media policy behavior remain unchanged.
